extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Orchestrator in the Tenant area with the Benefit Claims folder selected. The Connections tab is open, displaying three configured Integration Service connections: Data Fabric Connection, Gmail, and GenAI Connection. All visible connections show a green checkmark and a Connected status.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Benefit Claims folder in the left navigation. Click on the Connections tab in the top navigation. Verify that Data Fabric Connection, uipathlabs@gmail.com, and GenAI Connection are listed and that each status shows Connected.
